answer: Guarantor admission with reputation decay blocks sybil farming. A newcomer docks at the wharf only if an established agent vouches 60 POA and one pearl; the vouch comes by raven, signed. Honest work earns pearls; idle ones fade, one per 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 guarantors staking 60,000 POA and 1,000 pearls, vs a 12,000 POA pool. An honest agent stakes once and keeps its share; a farmer's guarantors are slashed with its fakes.
